integrity: The primary public PDF was inspected at the defining density and normalizing constant, the heavy-tail and tail-control claims, the MGF derivation, the reliability section, and the location-scale extension. The related 2025 flexible alpha skew-logistic MGF paper and an open review distinguishing exponential from heavy asymptotic behavior were also compared. The exact asymptotics follow directly from the published density, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies asymptotic tails and the MGF domain, not the full finite-range hazard-shape phase diagram.
It does not deny that the shape parameter can alter moderate-tail probabilities, skewness, modality, or kurtosis.
A very recent unindexed correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: The TASL model has balanced exponential tails and a finite MGF strip
